objects.name: VHH72 × SARS-CoV-2 RBD — AlphaBind optimization
objects.experiment: AlphaBind-designed VHH72 variants optimized against SARS-CoV-2 RBD, with 75% containing 4+ mutations from parent. Tested against a panel of 8 CoV-related antigens for cross-reactivity analysis.
objects.details:
- Sequence diversity: >28,000 unique VHH designs, with >75% of tested designs containing 4+ mutations away from parent
- Target diversity: 8 targets tested, including diverse variants of CoV-1 and CoV-2 RBD
- Scale: >226,000 unique VHH x antigen interactions
- Suitable for: affinity regressors, affinity optimization, generalizability testing to unseen targets

objects.name: VHH72 dSSM — paratope × epitope, SARS-CoV-1 RBD
objects.experiment: Deep site-saturation mutagenesis of the VHH72 paratope (>600 mutations, >30 positions) crossed against a SARS-CoV-1 RBD epitope library (>2,000 mutations, >100 positions), yielding >1M protein-protein interactions for local affinity landscape mapping.
objects.details:
- Paratope coverage: >600 mutations across >30 paratope positions
- Epitope coverage: >2,000 mutations across >100 epitope positions
- Scale: >1,000,000 protein–protein interactions (PPIs)
- Suitable for: affinity regressors, affinity optimization, exploring antigen sensitivity to a VHH

objects.name: Inverse Folding Models Benchmark — VHH72 (6WAQ) & anti-4-1BB (7D4B)
objects.experiment: Systematic benchmark of 8 inverse folding models (AbMPNN, ProteinMPNN, SaProt, AntiFold) on two VHH crystal structures, generating >40K designs validated against 3 targets via AlphaSeq. Only about 6% of designs match or exceed parental binding across all systems.
objects.details:
- Total designs: >15K designs per target, >40K total designs
- Targets: 3 targets (CoV-1 RBD, CoV-2 RBD, 4-1BB)
- Models tested: 8 inverse folding models ([AbMPNN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.19513), [proteinMPNN](https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/science.add2187), [SaProt](https://openreview.net/forum?id=6MRm3G4NiU), [AntiFold](https://academic.oup.com/bioinformaticsadvances/article/5/1/vbae202/8090019))
- Scale: >40K validated designs
- Suitable for: binder/non-binder classification, benchmarking IF models, testing design robustness across orthologs

objects.name: Synthetic Epitope Proteins (SEPs) — de novo minibinder pseudo-structures
objects.experiment: 25,448 synthetic epitope proteins designed via RFDiffusion + ProteinMPNN + Boltz-2, targeting 55 VHH parents and >250 antigen sequences. Includes ~1.4M AlphaSeq-validated PPIs, and comprehensive structure-confidence metrics (pTM, iPTM, pLDDT, ipSAE, pDockQ).
objects.details:
- VHHs sampled: 55 parent VHHs
- SEPs sampled: 25,448 synthetic epitope proteins and over 250 unique antigen sequences
- Scale: ~1.5M non-control interactions, 25,448 on-target interactions, ~1.4M off-target interactions
- Includes: Predicted VHH-SEP complex structures (CIF files)
- Suitable for: structure prediction, design filtering, de novo antibody design

objects.name: SAbDab-nano Local VHH Mutations × 118 Native Antigens
objects.experiment: ESM-filtered site-saturation mutagenesis of 184 VHH parents from SAbDab-nano crystal structures, yielding 11.9K unique VHH variants tested against 118 native antigens. 1.5M PPIs spanning on-target and off-target interactions for local affinity landscape analysis at scale.
objects.details:
- VHHs sampled: 184 parent VHHs + ~30-100 point mutations each (~11.9K unique VHHs)
- Antigens sampled: 118 antigens
- Scale: 1.5M PPIs, >12K on-target interactions
- Suitable for: affinity optimization, ML model training/validation, physics-based benchmarking

objects.name: Synthetic Epitope Proteins (SEPs) — de novo minibinder pseudo-structures with VHH single-mutant landscape
objects.experiment: 1,894 synthetic epitope proteins designed via RFDiffusion + ProteinMPNN + Boltz-2, targeting 21 parent VHHs plus single point mutants of each. Includes ~2.45M AlphaSeq-validated PPIs and predicted VHH-SEP complex structures with comprehensive confidence metrics (pTM, iPTM, pLDDT, ipSAE, pDockQ).
objects.details:
- VHHs sampled: 21 parent VHHs plus single point mutants (1,288 unique VHH sequences; 27-94 per parent, median 60)
- SEPs sampled: 1,894 synthetic epitope proteins
- Scale: ~2.45M non-control interactions (1,888 parental on-target + 111,615 mutant on-target + ~2.32M off-target)
- Hits (`alphaseq_affinity < 3`): 884 (18 parental + 866 mutant)
- Includes: predicted VHH-SEP complex structures for parental on-target PPIs (best model by ipSAE)
- Suitable for: structure prediction, design filtering, de novo antibody design, VHH single-mutant affinity modeling
